name: WatterSaver
description: $50 to enroll a smart electric water heater and $5/month to participate; shifts water heating to lower cost times
fullDescription: WatterSaver is a demand response program that pays customers to enroll their smart electric water heaters, automatically shifting water heating to off-peak times to save money and support the grid.
whatTheyOffer:
- $50 enrollment bonus
- $5 per month for participation
- Automatic water heating optimization
- Shifts heating to lower-cost times
- Hot water still available when you need it; you can pause participation anytime
- Time-of-use rate no longer required (as of March 2026)
howToGetIt:
1. Must be an electric customer of PG&E or a participating Community Choice Aggregator
2. Must have a qualifying smart heat pump or electric resistance water heater
3. Sign up on the WatterSaver website or call 888-707-9930
4. Connect water heater to Wi-Fi
5. Receive $50 enrollment bonus
6. Earn $5/month ongoing
keywords: WatterSaver, smart water heater, demand response, Rheem, A.O. Smith, Wi-Fi, energy savings, off-peak
